title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. I am in a muslim country in Asia pacific zone,I heard crab is halal and its bit common here among muslims. please let me know if it is allowed for a hanafi. 2. Once I had been to a Halal restaurant in Malaysia, They served soup, thinking its a chicken soup i had it, later I came to know that was Crab soup, I am too worried, please advice me what to do, if its haram food then what should I do to clean myself. Agar os khanay se badan ka koi hissa bana to, mout tak wo haram-khanay (CRAB) se bana huwa hissa mere badan may rahega, mai paak hona cahta houn, please hlep me. 4020 views Q. A few days ago, i went to a friend who is non muslim,where i ate chicken,later i came to know that chicken was not HALAL, Pls guide me what should i do now? 3195 views Q. Regarding food taken in canteen 2983 views Q. Is there any evidence from the Holy Quran or Ahadeeth prohibiting the eating of snails? 9886 views Q. It has been on the news that some UK retailers use sludge, human waste, as fertiliser on their fruits and vegetable. My question is; would it be permissible to consume such products? Should we refrain from eating them? 2882 views Q. assalamwalikum, mufti sahab aaaj kal pura anaj (foodgrains) hybrid aaraha hai, islamik shariya ke mutabik ye khana jayaz hai?.kya ye nizaam me dhakalbaazi kahee ja sakti hai kya? jaise ke hybrid ki jo paidawar hoti hai, woh insaaan kar raha hai (by making crosses of male and female parent).Doosari baat, maine aisa suna hai ke kuran/hadees me bhi likha hai ke "tum khajur ki do tahiniyo ko hilaoo taaki fertilization hoye" kya ye sahi hai? 2423 views Q. As you aware that there is lot of resturant,hotels etc who served chiken & mutton dishes,claiming that they are using HALAL chicken or Mutton. Just take an example,,KFC is world famous reataurant,some branches in delhi & other metro cities,who usually serve chicken dishes,,once,I visited the restaurant in Cannaught Place. Before having some chicken item,I asked the manager about the chicken,what type of the chicken they are using in the restaurant ??? He confirmed me that we are using only HALAL chicken in their stores in india. & also got a certificate from Jama masjid stating that KFC use only HALAL chicken in their stores in india. Now,Some days back,I visited their UK site, i.e. http://www.kfc.co.uk/faqs.aspx ,,on this link,there is question that chicken used i KFC is HALAL or not...then answer as mentioned on site is (Unfortunately we currently do not use Halal chicken in any of our stores.). Janab,I want to confirm that how is to eat at KFC restaurant.is it ok ?? or we,muslim community, have to fully avoid these restaurants?? 57348 views Q. My question is regarding alcohol. As in London in super stores if we work we need to serve alcohol like puting them in the shelf. In restaurants we need to serve them to Non-muslims and to few Muslims if they drink. So is I am allowed to work in the Superstores or in restaurants like dat? 2854 views Q. Is it permissible to eat the bone marrow of halal animal? 11287 views Q. Can we drink non-alcoholic beer 6216 views Q. Using spoon for drinking liquid food is correct or against SUNNAT? 3091 views Q. answer: Social Matters >> Food & Drinks Question ID: 150910 Country: India Title: I work at restaurant. Can I serve wine? Question: I work at restaurant. Can I serve wine? Answer ID: 150910 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 870/828/B=9/1438) No! It is haram. Quit this job and adopt some other job so that your income is halal. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
